_comment: Canonical macaroon byte-parity vectors, GENERATED FROM the canonical Rust impl (core/kernel/pd-anchor/src/macaroon.rs). Both the Rust test (kernel/pd-anchor/tests/parity_vectors.rs) and the TS test (tests/unit/macaroon-parity.test.js) assert their implementation reproduces these signatures byte-for-byte. If you change the construction in either language, regenerate this file from Rust and make both suites pass — that is what keeps I11 (runtime parity, ADR-0054) a theorem instead of a hope.
